Definition: from G3919; smuggled in:--unawares brought in.
BiblicalUsage: Pareisaktos means smuggled in, brought in unawares. It appears once, in Galatians 2:4, where false brethren unawares brought in come in privily to spy out the liberty believers have in Christ Jesus, that they might bring them into bondage.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the liberty of Christ is worth guarding, because the men who came to spy it out did not come to share it, they came to take it.
